Name: CS_SHADOW_QUALITY_DETAIL
Description: Shadow map settings for each level of the Shadow Quality option. Loaded from the system params, not regulation.bin. The whole param is ignored if its data version is not 2.

Fields.Name: Shadows Enabled
Fields.Description: Turns shadows on for this level.

Fields.Name: Maximum Filter Level
Fields.Description: Caps the shadow filter (softening) quality level; higher levels set by the scene are lowered to it.

Fields.Name: Resolution Multiplier
Fields.Description: Each shadow cascade's resolution = configured size × Multiplier ÷ Divider, then clamped between Minimum and Maximum Resolution.

Fields.Name: Resolution Divider
Fields.Description: Divides the configured shadow map resolution (see Resolution Multiplier).

Fields.Name: Minimum Resolution
Fields.Description: Lowest shadow map resolution per cascade, in pixels.

Fields.Name: Maximum Resolution
Fields.Description: Highest shadow map resolution per cascade, in pixels.

Fields.Name: Blur Count Offset
Fields.Description: Added to the configured shadow blur count; 0 leaves it unchanged.
